papers.title: SwapBot：借助可更换工具与触觉感知实现工具中心机器人操作
papers.titleEn: SwapBot: Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation via Interchangeable End-Effectors and Tactile Sensing
papers.summary: 日常烹饪要求机器人切换工具并感知接触。SwapBot把统一耦合接口、带触觉的工具适配器、遥操作和分层模仿学习连成系统，而非只展示机械结构。作者在十二人遥操作研究及真实豆腐操作中评估系统，报告触觉输入改善策略成功率。阅读时应区分定量豆腐实验与沙拉、翻肉等定性演示，不能据此推断通用厨房能力。
papers.summaryEn: Everyday cooking requires robots to switch tools and sense contact. SwapBot combines a common coupling interface, tactile tool adapters, teleoperation, and hierarchical imitation learning rather than presenting mechanics alone. The authors evaluate it in a twelve-person teleoperation study and real tofu manipulation, reporting improved policy success with tactile input. Distinguish quantitative tofu experiments from qualitative salad-stirring and meat-flipping demonstrations; these do not establish general kitchen competence.
papers.whySelected: 把工具接口、接触感知与学习闭环放在同一系统中，适合判断触觉信息何时真正改变操作策略。

xun.relation: 覆盖机器人触觉操作方向，非纯机械机构设计。

papers.title: 可变形物体形状伺服教程（一）：基础
papers.titleEn: A Tutorial on Shape Servoing of Deformable Objects-Part I: Fundamentals
papers.summary: 如何让机械臂把软物体调整到目标形状？这篇教程从形状特征出发，以局部变形雅可比连接机器人运动与视觉变化，串起离线估计、在线更新和反馈控制。双臂操纵平面弹性杆的仿真贯穿全文，并讨论局部稳定性与目标不可达问题。它适合建立控制直觉，但依赖准静态、可测形状与连续接触条件，不是动态布料操作的通用解法。
papers.summaryEn: How can robot arms shape a deformable object toward a target? This tutorial starts with shape features and uses a local deformation Jacobian to connect robot motion to visual changes, combining offline estimation, online updates, and feedback control. A simulated planar elastic rod manipulated by two arms illustrates local stability and unreachable targets. It builds control intuition, but assumes quasistatic motion, measurable shape, and continuous contact conditions; it is not a general solution to dynamic cloth manipulation.
papers.whySelected: 有完整闭环和可核验教程代码，适合补齐可变形物体操作中模型估计与反馈控制的基础。

papers.title: 用多臂老虎机实现路径受限移动传感器的自适应搜索
papers.titleEn: Adaptive search with path-constrained mobile sensors using multi-arm bandits
papers.summary: 移动传感器既要从噪声观测中找到重点区域，又受电量、障碍和运动约束。本文先离线构建可行路径覆盖，再把在线路径分配写成多臂老虎机问题，以置信界决定下一轮采样。作者给出概率正确性与搜索时间界，并用数值仿真分析路径冗余和团队规模。其保证针对已知图与统计观测模型，不能直接等同于真实无人机系统的任务成功保证。
papers.summaryEn: Mobile sensors must locate regions of interest from noisy observations while respecting energy, obstacle, and motion constraints. The paper first constructs feasible path covers offline, then formulates online path assignment as a multi-armed bandit problem using confidence bounds to choose sampling. It provides probabilistic correctness and search-time bounds, with simulations examining path redundancy and team size. These guarantees concern a known graph and statistical observation model, not end-to-end mission success for physical drones.
papers.whySelected: 把主动感知的统计采样需求与机器人可行路径约束连接起来，拓宽仅关注学习策略的阅读视角。

papers.title: 别冒险：面向纯激光雷达人群导航的轨迹条件分布风险
papers.titleEn: Don't Risk It!: Trajectory-Conditioned Distributional Risk for LiDAR-Only Crowd Navigation
papers.summary: 在人群中导航，预测占据地图准确并不等于候选轨迹安全。DRIP直接读取激光雷达栅格历史，预测轨迹相关的最小间距分布，并用碰撞风险监督不确定性，再对采样轨迹排序。作者在最多四十五名行人的仿真及两类实机上评估，实机二十次试验成功十七次。结果值得关注，但样本有限，学习风险分数不构成形式化安全认证。
papers.summaryEn: Accurate occupancy prediction does not necessarily make a candidate path safe in crowds. DRIP takes LiDAR-grid histories, predicts trajectory-conditioned minimum-clearance distributions, supervises uncertainty using collision risk, and ranks sampled trajectories. The authors evaluate simulations with up to forty-five pedestrians and two physical platforms, reporting seventeen successes in twenty hardware trials. The results are promising but limited in sample size; a learned risk score is not a formal safety certification.
papers.whySelected: 把预测不确定性直接对齐下游规划风险，并提供可核验实现，是感知—规划接口的具体案例。

papers.title: 并行监测任务下月球机械臂遥操作的视线辅助监督控制
papers.titleEn: Gaze-Assisted Supervisory Control for Lunar Robotic Arm Teleoperation Under Concurrent Monitoring
papers.summary: 操作者一边监测系统、一边遥控机械臂时，持续摇杆控制可能增加负担。本文让视线提名目标、按键明确确认，再交由机器人完成有限自主抓放。十六人的月球任务类比虚拟现实实验中，平均单块岩石操作时间从四十七点六五秒降至十八点四三秒，但精细放置仍是人工控制更准确。适合思考按任务阶段分配自主权，而不是一概替代人工。
papers.summaryEn: Continuous joystick control can burden an operator who must also monitor system states. This paper uses gaze to nominate a target and a button to explicitly confirm it, followed by bounded autonomous grasp-and-place execution. In a sixteen-person lunar-mission-analog virtual-reality study, mean time per rock fell from 47.65 to 18.43 seconds, but manual control remained more accurate for precision placement. It motivates allocating autonomy by task stage rather than universally replacing human control.
papers.whySelected: 提供效率与精度相冲突的人机实验，不只展示更快结果，也解释何时需要保留人工细调。

papers.title: GDPView：统一删除传播变体的交互界面
papers.titleEn: GDPView: An Interactive Interface that Unifies Variants of Deletion Propagation (DP)
tags: 较早论文 · 首次发现
papers.summary: 这是昨日广义删除传播算法的独立交互演示后续。系统用删除、保留、最小化和最大化四类操作描述视图目标，并展示源元组删除、见证及整数规划约束之间的联系。适合思考如何让用户检查更新副作用；但它面向合取查询删除，不是完整的本体映射更新器，大规模效果仍引用前作。
papers.summaryEn: This is a separate interactive demonstration following yesterday’s generalized deletion-propagation algorithm. Four operations—delete, preserve, minimize and maximize—specify view goals, with displays connecting source-tuple deletions, witnesses and ILP constraints. It is useful for thinking about user inspection of update side effects, but targets deletions for conjunctive queries, not a complete ontology-and-mapping update engine; large-scale evidence still comes from the earlier work.
papers.whySelected: 从算法到可解释更新界面的直接后续；独立DOI，非昨日论文换名重复。

li.whyRead: 重点看四种原语如何组合更新意图，并通过见证导航解释副作用。
li.relation: 可作为固定VKG实例更新的交互层设计参照；将本体推理、映射和源完整性约束纳入系统仍是另需证明的研究步骤，不能直接套用。

limits: 演示论文，不是新的复杂度定理；通用GDP仍NP-hard，可解类保证来自2025前作。
未验证本体蕴含、R2RML、插入或任意源约束修复能力。
解释面板仅对配置大小内的小实例启用；本篇未新增大规模基准。

papers.title: ScheduleGen：以技能调度生成多臂模仿学习示范
papers.titleEn: ScheduleGen: Demonstration Generation via Skill Scheduling for Multi-Arm Imitation Learning
papers.summary: 多臂模仿学习不仅缺数据，还需避免机械臂相互碰撞。ScheduleGen从少量示范保留接触技能，结合运动规划与联合时间调度生成新轨迹。作者在28个仿真变体上报告79.6%的生成成功率，所得策略平均成功率65.5%；八个真实变体为50%至80%。适合学习数据生成与协调控制的接口，但真实评估每项仅20回合。
papers.summaryEn: Multi-arm imitation learning needs data that also avoids collisions between arms. ScheduleGen preserves contact skills from a few demonstrations and combines motion planning with joint temporal scheduling to generate new trajectories. The authors report 79.6% generation success and 65.5% mean learned-policy success across 28 simulation variants; eight real-world variants achieve 50–80%. It is useful for studying the interface between data generation and coordinated control, though each hardware variant has only 20 evaluation episodes.

papers.title: Gym-Anything：让数字智能体扩展机器人物理仿真
papers.titleEn: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
papers.summary: 手工构建机器人仿真难以覆盖多样物理任务。本文用编程智能体创建环境，再以对抗式审计检查物理与奖励，构建25类仿真、200个强化学习环境的RoboWorld。作者报告初始测试任务对受测模型很困难，并探索特权状态指导和代码示范训练VLA。代码已核实，但项目网页暂不可访问；阅读重点应是审计标准，而非把模拟成功等同真实部署。
papers.summaryEn: Hand-built robot simulations struggle to cover diverse physical tasks. This work uses coding agents to create environments and adversarial audits to check physics and rewards, producing RoboWorld with 200 reinforcement-learning environments across 25 simulations. The authors find the initial test tasks difficult for the evaluated models and explore privileged-state guidance and code-generated demonstrations for VLA training. The code repository was verified, but the project website was inaccessible. Focus on the auditing criteria rather than equating simulation success with real deployment.
papers.whySelected: 提供可检查的环境、任务与审计实现，便于比较仿真可信度和学习接口。

papers.title: SONIC-K1：在单GPU上把通用动作跟踪迁移到小型人形机器人
papers.titleEn: SONIC-K1: Porting a Universal Humanoid Motion Tracker to a Small Humanoid on a Single GPU
papers.summary: SONIC-K1将已有全身动作跟踪框架迁移到较小的Booster K1，在共享单卡上重新训练，并公开代码与权重。作者在MuJoCo留出动作集上报告97.4%成功率，但这是指定判据下的仿真结果。真机仅作定性测试，迈步和转身仍不稳定。短文清楚交代迁移配方、延迟敏感性与评估缺口，适合作为人形强化学习复现前的阅读材料。
papers.summaryEn: SONIC-K1 ports an existing whole-body motion-tracking framework to the smaller Booster K1, retrains it on one shared GPU, and releases code and weights. The authors report 97.4% success on held-out motions in MuJoCo, but this is a simulation result under a specified criterion. Hardware testing is qualitative, and stepping and turning remain unreliable. The short paper clearly describes the porting recipe, latency sensitivity, and evaluation gaps, making it useful preparation before reproducing humanoid reinforcement learning.
papers.whySelected: 短文、可核验代码和权重、明确失败边界，便于学习而不是只看高成功率。
